puntus.title: Puntus — Loyalty Platform
puntus.cardDescription:
Co-founder & developer of Puntus — a SaaS loyalty platform helping Latin American businesses run their own digital points-and-rewards programs, accessible directly from Apple Wallet and Google Wallet with no extra app required.

Involved end-to-end: product decisions, architecture, and writing the code that powers the no-code rule engine, real-time analytics, and a multi-tenant cloud setup with AES-256 encryption. Live in production today.

detail.body1:
I'm co-founder and developer of Puntus — a SaaS loyalty platform built for Latin American small and mid-sized businesses. We let merchants run their own digital points and rewards programs in minutes, with cards customers access directly from Apple Wallet or Google Wallet — no extra app to download.

This is the project I'm most proud of: not just because of what it does, but because I've been involved end-to-end — from the initial idea and product decisions, all the way down to writing the code that powers it in production.
detail.body2:
On the engineering side, the stack is Next.js and React on the frontend, NestJS with TypeScript on the backend, PostgreSQL through Prisma as the database, Redis for caching, and everything containerized with Docker in a multi-tenant cloud setup with AES-256 encryption.

I worked on the no-code rule engine that lets merchants define point-earning and reward logic without touching a single line of code, the real-time business analytics, and the integrations with popular POS systems in the region.

Beyond the tech, Puntus is about giving small businesses the same fidelization tools that big chains have — at a price they can actually afford and in their own language. Seeing it live, used by real merchants, is the most rewarding part.

calorie-calculator.title: Calorie Calculator
calorie-calculator.cardDescription: A simple app you can use to convert macronutrients, such as <accent>Carbs, Protein, Fat and Alcohol</accent> to their equivalent values in <accent>Calories</accent>.

detail.body1:
A simple app you can use to convert macronutrients, such as Carbs, Protein, Fat and Alcohol to their equivalent values in Calories.

This tool is perfect for anyone tracking their nutrition or learning about the caloric content of different macronutrients. It provides quick and accurate conversions to help users make informed dietary decisions.
detail.body2:
Built with React for a dynamic and interactive user experience, this calculator features real-time calculations and a clean, intuitive interface. The app uses Bootstrap for responsive design and JavaScript for the calculation logic.

The application includes input validation, instant results, and a user-friendly design that makes nutrition tracking accessible to everyone.

aesthetic-clock.title: Aesthetic Clock
aesthetic-clock.cardDescription:
A simple clock designed to be your company while being productive.

You can have it running in the background to get you in the flow, and also be aware of the time. 😃

detail.body1:
An aesthetic clock application that combines functionality with beautiful design. This project showcases the power of CSS animations and JavaScript to create an engaging and visually appealing time display.

The clock features smooth animations, elegant typography, and a minimalist design that makes it both practical and visually stunning.
detail.body2:
Built with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, this project demonstrates advanced CSS techniques including animations, gradients, and responsive design. The clock updates in real-time and features smooth transitions.

The design focuses on aesthetics while maintaining functionality, creating a perfect balance between form and function.
